title: Reservoirs mark, but do not make, drought vulnerability: storage buffering reflects siting, not regulation, across Chile — data and code
description: Data and code archive for the manuscript. Contains the analysis pipeline (R/targets), the study's primary reservoir storage and capacity dataset, DGA watershed units, analysis-ready per-unit panels that reproduce the statistics without the large raster inputs, all result tables and figures, and the Quarto manuscript sources. Large third-party raster inputs (CHIRPS/CHIRTS, MODIS, MapBiomas, CR2 streamflow, SRTM, Koppen-Geiger, Catastro Fruticola) are public and documented in DATA_SOURCES.md rather than redistributed.
